# Bramley Foods: model assurance

**Date:** Wednesday 7 October 2026

###### 00:00 - 00:22
**Jack Merrow**

Our risk committee wants to see how the model was evaluated before we go further.

###### 00:22 - 00:49
**Dom Selvon**

Nadia will send you the model card and the evaluation results by Thursday next week.

###### 00:49 - 01:03
**Nadia Kaur**

I have most of it already, so that is achievable.

###### 01:03 - 01:16
**Jack Merrow**

Good. Send it to me rather than the committee directly.

expected.description: Nadia Kaur to send Jack Merrow the model card and evaluation results
expected.evidenceQuote: Nadia will send you the model card and the evaluation results by Thursday next week.

notes: A Valliance colleague commits on Dom side, so the direction is outbound and the counterparty is the client.
